title: MZ RPG Maker MZ Walkover text

posts.author: xanax48
posts.body:
I'm attempting to recreate something akin to the FF12 License Board system. I've managed to account for the stat gains and progression, but I can't find a way to walkover the events that display text without requiring some kind of cancel input from the player. My vision is as followed:
Player to walk over an event.
Player walks over an event.
Event causes text to display on the screen showing possible stat gain.
Player continues to use directional buttons to maneuver over other stat upgrades.
If player presses action button, text displays if they want to buy that upgrade.
Any ideas?

When using the event as is above, the player can't move while the text box in still on the screen. If I had several of these events side by side like in the FF12 LB  I could not walk over the events continuously. The player would pause every time the text box appeared.
As stated, I would like to know if text can be displayed when a the player walks over the even, without locking the players movement until the text box is confirmed/cancel. This actually has nothing to do with the Choice of buying the upgrade or not.

There are different ways you can do this.
Either you use a plugin like DTextPicture.js which transforms text as image so you can display it on screen, use a text display plugin, show picture instead etc. Then you will use conditional branch -> input to see if the player pressed confirm/OK before disposing the display.
If thou must move the player during dialogue, you would need to find a plugin that disables that part of the core script. There are discussions about like this one!
https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/inde...ement-while-using-the-show-text-event.153873/
or create a custom ui plugin that emulates the look of show text and function differently.

THANK YOU!!!
I found a plugin that works as you described (Visustella - Visual Text Window)
With it, I've created two categories of events. The first are stat boosting, and the second erases the window. So basically if you walk over the event a window will display the relevant text. If you walk over an empty area, the text is erased, and if you walk over one stat boost after another, the text is replaced with the new info.
All without disabling the players movements. VICTORY!
